title: Ollama Variables
description: Ollama group: local-LLM server provisioning parameters. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'ollama'.

ollamaOperations.description: Ordered, non-empty list of Ollama operations to run. Supply at ansible-playbook runtime with -e.

ollamaPort.description: TCP port the Ollama API server listens on. The ollama role opens this port in the host firewall (UFW on Linux). Role default in roles/ollama/defaults/main.yml; override per host/group or with -e ollamaPort=....
